verdict.rationale: Groq's docs and early hands-on reports strongly support extreme throughput (491 T/s Mixtral, 450+ tps) and documents streaming, flex/service tiers for latency-throughput tuning, but later independent community reports concretely contradict the speed/value claim, citing poor performance-for-price versus competitors, random errors, and unreliable behavior (e.g., 'performance is really poor for the token price', 'double the tokens per second... elsewhere', 'so many random errors'). Missing for 10: consistent independent benchmarks confirming sustained fast TTFT/throughput across models and no contradicting real-world reports.
